name: @workbench/app
description: Workbench: projects, terminals and coding agents in one window
author: Patrick Roth

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Workbench uses the microphone for voice dictation: press dictate and what you say is typed into the active pane.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Workbench runs your Claude Code sessions and terminals. They open and edit project files kept on your Desktop.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Workbench runs your Claude Code sessions and terminals. They open and edit project files kept in Documents.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Workbench's Claude sessions and terminals read files in Downloads (photos, PDFs, installers) when you ask them to.
extendInfo.NSRemovableVolumesUsageDescription: Workbench's Claude sessions and terminals read or write a USB drive or SD card when you ask them to.
extendInfo.NSNetworkVolumesUsageDescription: Workbench's Claude sessions and terminals read or write a network share when you ask them to.
extendInfo.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Workbench's Claude sessions look at pictures in your Photos library when you ask them to.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Workbench's Claude sessions script other apps when you ask them to.
extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Workbench's terminals and Claude sessions connect to machines on your local network when you ask them to.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Workbench has no use for the camera. Something it started asked anyway — choose Don't Allow unless you know why.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Workbench has no use for recording your Mac's audio. Something it started asked anyway — choose Don't Allow unless you know why.
extendInfo.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Workbench has no use for Bluetooth. Something it started asked anyway — choose Don't Allow unless you know why.
extendInfo.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Workbench has no use for Bluetooth. Something it started asked anyway — choose Don't Allow unless you know why.
